paragraphs.text: Garulsz was the ogre bartender of the Backwater , the Tenth District tavern which was frequented by Agrus Kos while he was a Wojek .
As an ogre, Garulsz had limited Ravi, with typically stunted grammar. Her favorite passion was to rub the tavern's glasses free of smears.

Garulsz was present when the drunk Agrus Kos decided to pick a fight with a polite, well-spoken minotaur in her tavern, hoping to get punched out. Kos ended up being thrown into the tavern's sturdy chandelier, which he was still hanging in when Bell Borca came to pick him up for his promotion.

12 years later, Garulsz and Kos happened upon each other again in the Utvara Flats. He had bought a tower in the Utvaran settlement to look for Feather , while she had bought a plot in the flats to start prospecting. She helped guide Kos and Pivlic on their way toward the rescue of Crix , and later received the cure for the kuga plague. She also participated in Kos's funeral prosession a few days later.
